name: Major Project Part I
description: This project-based course provides students with the opportunity to undertake in-depth research or development in integrated electronics, circuits and systems area, applying concepts from integrated circuits and intelligent systems sub-domains mainly. With the help of a faculty mentor, students identify a real-world problem, design a circuit, system or algorithmic solution, and validate it through industry relevant simulation tools and experimentation.
